content: @dsl.component(base_image=..., packages_to_install=[...]) auto-builds a lightweight Python-function component at compile/run time layering pip installs onto base_image -- fine for demos, fragile/slow for CI-graded production repos (installs at runtime, no build provenance). @dsl.container_component + dsl.ContainerSpec(image=, command=, args=) references a pre-built, CI-pushed image (e.g. GHCR tag) -- the credible production pattern: image built and tested in CI, immutable tag referenced by the pipeline, no runtime pip install.
